description: This file defines the class 'HTMLPurifier_VarParser_Native', which implements a variable parser using PHP's internal eval functionality within the HTMLPurifier project. It provides methods to parse and evaluate expressions using PHP's eval, with a note on potential security risks.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_VarParser_Native
classes.description: A variable parser class that uses PHP's eval to interpret expressions, inheriting from HTMLPurifier_VarParser.

methods.name: parseImplementation
methods.description: Parses the variable using eval by calling evalExpression with the provided expression.

methods.name: evalExpression
methods.description: Evaluates a PHP expression string using eval, capturing the variable's value while handling errors.
